About The Role

AI is being asked to solve some of the world's most complex environmental problems — but it needs expert guidance to get it right. That's where you come in.

We're looking for environmental engineers to help train and evaluate advanced AI models on topics like water and wastewater treatment, air quality management, hazardous waste remediation, and environmental compliance. Your expertise will directly shape how AI reasons through real-world engineering challenges — making models smarter, safer, and more technically rigorous.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. Work on your own schedule, 10–40 hours per week.

Design Complex Engineering Problems — Create advanced, domain-specific challenges spanning contaminant transport, mass balance in treatment plants, hydrology, Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), and more
Author Ground-Truth Solutions — Develop rigorous, step-by-step technical responses — including chemical dosage calculations, hydraulic flow models, and pollutant dispersion simulations — that serve as benchmark answers for AI training
Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI-generated remediation plans, environmental impact statements, and mathematical proofs for technical accuracy, regulatory compliance (EPA, ISO 14001), and safety

Strong foundational knowledge in one or more of: aquatic chemistry, wastewater process design, air quality engineering, or hazardous waste remediation
Able to communicate complex engineering and ecological concepts clearly and precisely in writing
Detail-oriented — you catch unit conversion errors, flawed chemical equations, and regulatory logic gaps
No prior AI experience required — we'll get you up to speed

Experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or evaluation workflows
Familiarity with environmental modeling software (e.g., SWMM, AERMOD, EPA models)
Background in EHS compliance or environmental consulting

Work on cutting-edge AI projects in collaboration with world-leading AI research labs
Fully remote and async — work when and where it suits you
